reviews.comment:
Desde hacian meses no llegaba a dicha estacion por no contar con baños adecuados.
Hoy la vi refaccionada, con una atencion excelente, buen servicio y me llamò la atenciòn la higiene de los baños con todos los elementos necesarios y en estado impecable. Recomiendo la llegada a èse lugar.

(Translated by Google)
I hadn't been to that station for months because it didn't have adequate restrooms.
Today I saw it renovated, with excellent service and great attention. I was particularly impressed by the cleanliness of the restrooms, which were fully equipped and in impeccable condition. I highly recommend stopping there.
